what: Strata SQ-15 on one Kaggle T4, first real headless measurement
hardware: 2x Tesla T4 (15360 MiB each), sm75; run used one card

vram_after_load_mib.note: both cards show usage; the pack spans them even though only one was targeted

dspark.reason_from_strata_itself: Drafting off: a 128-token probe on this card measured 0.98x with drafting (code 0.98x, chat 0.98x) (plain decoding 19 tok/s); it needs 1.10x.

verdict: Strata runs Inkling 2 Mini headless on a T4 at 18.3-19 tok/s. Its built-in DSpark draft is auto-disabled on sm75 because acceptance does not beat the 1.10x break-even. That is a measured negative result for speculative decoding on T4 and it contradicts the plan's assumption that spec decode is the route to 60 tok/s on this card.
